conclusion: Compare measured frame cycles and implementation timing before selecting the final integration candidate. Review unattended section6 decisions with the user tomorrow.

purpose:

HLS resources 1032DSP/146BRAM18K/128849LUT/193984FF pass the current screening limits while the original infeasible status remains. Generated top RTL conditionally bypasses the scalar-bias AR/R states when do_load is false; this static inspection is not zero-AXI acceptance. C29 four-call C semantics and C30 fresh-process flag0 fallback pass. C27 completes all four exact RTL outputs but both skipped calls still read4bytes; keep its fail status, unchanged RTL hashes and raw diagnostic measurements. Independently repeat the four calls, strict zero skipped AR/R/AW/W activity, latency ordering and before/after synthesis RTL checks under the existing one-heavy scheduler and cumulative six-hour timeout. Run load/reuse/reload/latest-bank retention as four complete transactions. Butterfly and ignored-pointer lenna must be E065-exact; constructed loaded and retained outputs must equal104/256 everywhere.
